Role Summary

Responsible for developing communication materials, coordinating content delivery, and supporting corporate citizenship program execution to ensure timely delivery, consistent messaging, and effective implementation aligned with IOH’s priorities.

Scope of Work

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Content Development & Execution

• Develop communication materials based on approved narratives and briefs.
• Support the implementation of communication plans and content activities.
• Ensure content accuracy, quality, and consistency with IOH’s messaging.

Program Coordination & Field Execution

• Coordinate corporate citizenship activities with internal teams, partners, and field stakeholders.
• Support on-site implementation and resolve routine operational issues.
• Document program activities and gather information on outcomes and stakeholder feedback.

Project Tracking & Reporting

• Track deliverables, timelines, and progress across assigned communications and citizenship activities.
• Compile data and prepare reports on communication performance and program implementation.

Qualification:

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
• Good written and spoken English, with strong writing and presentation skills.

Related Experience:

• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in public relations, corporate communications, content development, or related fields.
• Experience working at a PR agency, communications agency, or corporate communications function is preferred.
• Experience coordinating communication projects, events, or community programs is an advantage.

Skills:

• Content writing and storytelling
• Communication material development
• Project coordination and execution
• Stakeholder and partner coordination
• Reporting and documentation

Job Responsibilities

Content Development and Management
External Communications
Reputation Management
Strategic Communications Planning

Carry out daily Parent Stock farm activities according to work instructions and SOPs.
Perform routine tasks such as feeding, egg collection, cleaning, and flock care.
Observe and report flock conditions, mortality, and operational abnormalities to the supervisor.
Follow biosecurity, animal welfare, safety, and hygiene requirements at all times.
Maintain cleanliness of facilities, equipment, and work areas.
Record daily operational data accurately as instructed.
Support team activities to ensure smooth and efficient farm operations.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
